name: seo-dashboard
description: A custom SEO dashboard for ChatGPT, built on OpenAI's Plugin Extensions (MCP Extensions): daily rank tracking via Apify, Google Search Console clicks, impressions and a performance report, competitors, SERP insights and a site check, in the ChatGPT sidebar.

interface.longDescription: Your SEO dashboard in the ChatGPT desktop app, built with OpenAI Plugin Extensions. Track up to 200 keywords per project and five competitor domains. See Google positions, changes over 1, 7 and 30 days, visibility, share of voice, People Also Ask questions, related searches and AI overviews when available. Connect Google Search Console for clicks, impressions, CTR and average position, plus reports comparing 7, 28 or 90 days with the previous period. Check your own pages for missing titles, noindex, redirects and slow responses. Ask ChatGPT to explain changes and suggest what to work on next. Install from the public GitHub marketplace. Requires the desktop app with plugin support and Node.js 22 or newer. Enter your own Apify API key and optional Google service-account JSON in dashboard Settings. Credentials and dashboard history are stored locally on your computer. Direct refreshes run while the local plugin is running; Google Search Console syncs are read-only. The plugin is free. Apify charges your own account for ranking refreshes. Data returned to a conversation is shared with ChatGPT as part of that conversation.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on for SEO this week?
